section_label: Table 3 - Bond Lengths and Angles, Modification I

analytics.raw_text: Table 3 (printed Tabelle 3) gives the bond lengths in [Angstrom] and bond angles in [degrees] of crystal modification I from the single-crystal structure analysis: 73 rows, 29 bond lengths from 1.219 to 1.784 Angstrom and 44 bond angles from 103.72 to 125.3 degrees. Lines 253 to 354. The full list is in the source.

notes: Same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S: identical atoms and bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice. It is not a distinct chemical entity, it is crystal modification I of tembotrione. Table 3 is analytical data on one refined structure. Every label in the bond column (printed Bindung), for example Cl(1)-C(3) or F(2)-C(10)-F(3), is a pair or triple of atoms inside this one molecule, named by their position in the asymmetric unit. They are atoms, not compounds, and none of them was emitted as a record. Referenced from paragraph [0013].
